SoilMix.Description: Well-draining acidic mix ideal for silver firs. Mimics native mountain forest soil.

HomeRemedies.Title: Neem Oil Spray for Aphids
HomeRemedies.Description: Controls common aphid infestations on fir needles without harming beneficial insects.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Mix 2 tsp neem oil with 1 tsp dish soap in 1 litre of warm water. Spray on affected branches every 7 days until clear.

HomeRemedies.Title: Acidic Compost Tea
HomeRemedies.Description: Boosts soil acidity and nutrient availability for conifers.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Steep 2 cups of pine bark compost in 4 litres of water for 24 hours. Water around the base every 2 weeks in spring.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Prefers dappled shade to partial sun; avoid harsh afternoon exposure
CareProfile.WaterDetails: Keep soil consistently moist; water deeply once a week in dry spells
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Remove dead or damaged branches in late winter before new growth
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -20°C; protect young trees from late spring frosts

SoilMix.Description: Slightly acidic, free-draining mix suited for columnar conifers in garden beds.

HomeRemedies.Title: Garlic Spray for Mites
HomeRemedies.Description: Repels spider mites that commonly infest compact fir cultivars.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Blend 4 garlic cloves in 500ml water, strain, dilute to 1 litre. Spray undersides of branches weekly.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Thrives in full sun to partial shade; columnar form suits open positions
CareProfile.WaterDetails: Water regularly when young; established trees tolerate brief dry periods
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Only remove crossing or damaged branches; avoid cutting into old wood
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Frost-hardy to -25°C; very tolerant of cold mountain climates

SoilMix.Description: Drought-tolerant mix for blue-needled conifers. Excellent drainage prevents root rot.

HomeRemedies.Title: Cinnamon Bark Dust
HomeRemedies.Description: Prevents fungal issues at the root zone in warm, humid conditions.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Dust ground cinnamon lightly around the base of the trunk after watering. Reapply every 10 days.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Full sun preferred; the blue-silver foliage intensifies with more light
CareProfile.WaterDetails: Drought-tolerant once established; water sparingly, allow topsoil to dry between waterings
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Prune only to remove dead wood; natural pyramidal form needs no shaping
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -30°C; one of the most cold-tolerant fir cultivars

SoilMix.Description: Moist yet airy soil for Fraser Fir, mimicking cool Appalachian highland conditions.

HomeRemedies.Title: Epsom Salt Boost
HomeRemedies.Description: Corrects magnesium deficiency causing yellowing needles.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Dissolve 1 tbsp Epsom salt in 4 litres of water. Apply to soil around tree base once a month in growing season.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Partial sun to full sun; appreciates some afternoon shade in hot climates
CareProfile.WaterDetails: Consistent moisture preferred; mulch well to retain soil humidity
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Light tip pruning in early spring encourages dense branching
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -25°C; native to cool Appalachian highlands above 1500m

SoilMix.Description: Rich organic mix that supports the slow-growing golden foliage of this ornamental fir.

HomeRemedies.Title: Banana Peel Potassium Feed
HomeRemedies.Description: Encourages vibrant golden needle color with natural potassium.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Bury 2 dried banana peels 5cm deep around the drip line. Refresh monthly during spring and summer.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Partial sun; morning sun with afternoon shade keeps golden foliage from scorching
CareProfile.WaterDetails: Regular watering needed; soil should stay moist but never waterlogged
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Lightly prune after new growth emerges to maintain compact shape
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -20°C; mulch roots in first few winters after planting

SoilMix.Description: Fast-draining alkaline mix for this drought-hardy Spanish fir. Mimics rocky limestone hillsides.

HomeRemedies.Title: Wood Ash Soil Sweetener
HomeRemedies.Description: Raises soil pH slightly and adds potassium for this alkaline-preferring species.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Sprinkle 1/4 cup of wood ash around base, rake lightly into soil. Use once per season.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Full sun essential; needs 6+ hours daily to maintain its dense blue-grey foliage
CareProfile.WaterDetails: Low water needs once established; highly drought-tolerant in rocky soils
CareProfile.PruningDetails: No routine pruning needed; remove dead inner branches in autumn only
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -15°C; protect from cold, drying winds in exposed sites

SoilMix.Description: Rich, moisture-retentive soil for this impressive native fir tree.

HomeRemedies.Title: Coffee Ground Mulch
HomeRemedies.Description: Acidifies soil slightly and deters slugs from young saplings.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Spread a thin layer of used coffee grounds around the base. Do not pile against trunk. Reapply every 3 weeks.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Full sun; large stature demands an open position with unrestricted light
CareProfile.WaterDetails: Deep weekly watering in summer; well-established trees need little supplemental water
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Remove lower limbs in winter to raise canopy; avoid over-pruning
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -25°C; native to Pacific Northwest mountains, very cold tolerant

SoilMix.Description: Well-draining acidic mix that promotes vibrant foliage color in Japanese maples.

HomeRemedies.Title: Seaweed Foliar Spray
HomeRemedies.Description: Boosts overall plant vigor and improves stress tolerance.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Dilute 2 tbsp liquid seaweed in 1 litre of water. Spray foliage in the morning every 2 weeks in spring.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Partial sun to light shade; 3–4 hours of direct sun per day is ideal
CareProfile.WaterDetails: Keep evenly moist; water when top 2cm of soil feels dry, especially in summer
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Prune before buds break to shape canopy and remove weak growth
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -15°C; protect pot-grown specimens from hard freeze

SoilMix.Description: Humus-rich moist soil replicating woodland floor conditions for this ornamental bark maple.

HomeRemedies.Title: Leaf Mould Top Dress
HomeRemedies.Description: Keeps roots cool and adds organic matter through the growing season.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Apply 5cm layer of decomposed leaf mould around base in early spring. Do not place against bark.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Partial shade preferred; the distinctive striped bark shows best in dappled light
CareProfile.WaterDetails: Moderate watering; keep soil moist in summer, reduce in winter
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Prune when fully dormant to retain the ornamental open branching structure
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -20°C; young specimens benefit from wind protection in first winter

SoilMix.Description: Fertile but free-draining mix for the slow-growing paperbark maple with its spectacular cinnamon bark.

HomeRemedies.Title: Fish Emulsion Feed
HomeRemedies.Description: Encourages healthy slow growth and rich autumn color.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Dilute fish emulsion 1:10 with water. Apply to soil around drip line every 4 weeks, spring to midsummer only.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Partial sun to full sun; autumn colour is most vivid in sunny positions
CareProfile.WaterDetails: Moderate; water weekly in summer heat, less in cool seasons
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Minimal pruning only — remove dead wood and inward-crossing branches
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -20°C; the cinnamon bark is more susceptible to frost damage than the canopy

SoilMix.Description: Classic Japanese-style maple mix — moisture-retentive with great drainage for autumn color.

HomeRemedies.Title: Rice Water Foliar Feed
HomeRemedies.Description: Provides trace minerals and promotes dense, lush leaf growth.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Use strained water from rinsing white rice. Apply to foliage and soil once per week during summer.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Partial shade; the broad palmate leaves scorch easily in strong midday sun
CareProfile.WaterDetails: Keep consistently moist spring through summer; reduce watering in winter
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Prune lightly before bud break; remove dead tips and improve airflow through centre
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -20°C; shelter from desiccating cold winds which damage leaf margins

SoilMix.Description: Superb bonsai-inspired mix for potted Japanese maples. Retains moisture without waterlogging.

HomeRemedies.Title: Neem Oil Preventive Spray
HomeRemedies.Description: Prevents scale insects and aphids before they colonize the delicate foliage.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Mix 1 tsp neem oil, 0.5 tsp dish soap in 1 litre of water. Spray all leaf surfaces fortnightly from spring.

HomeRemedies.Title: Worm Casting Tea
HomeRemedies.Description: Gentle balanced fertiliser that feeds without risk of leaf scorch.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Soak 1 cup worm castings in 2 litres of water overnight. Strain and water the base of the plant weekly in spring.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Indirect to partial light; direct afternoon sun causes leaf scorch on indoor specimens
CareProfile.WaterDetails: Keep soil moist but never soggy; check moisture with finger before each watering
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Prune crossing branches and thin dense areas after the last frost in spring
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -20°C outdoors; indoor plants need protection from cold draughts and heating vents

SoilMix.Description: Nutrient-rich acidic mix that intensifies the deep burgundy-red pigmentation.

HomeRemedies.Title: Apple Cider Vinegar Acidifier
HomeRemedies.Description: Lowers soil pH to enhance leaf color intensity in purple-leaved maples.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Add 1 tbsp ACV to 4 litres of water. Use in place of regular watering once per month. Do not over-apply.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Partial sun; 4–6 hours of morning sun deepens the burgundy-red leaf colour
CareProfile.WaterDetails: Regular watering; keep evenly moist, especially in summer. Avoid letting soil dry completely
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Remove congested growth and dead tips; thinning improves air circulation and colour
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -20°C; mulch roots heavily in colder zones to protect crown

SoilMix.Description: Airy, well-draining mix that prevents root rot in the delicate laceleaf varieties.

HomeRemedies.Title: Chamomile Tea Drench
HomeRemedies.Description: Prevents damping off and mild fungal issues in humid conditions.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Brew strong chamomile tea, cool, and dilute 1:5 with water. Water the soil base once a week during humid weather.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Partial sun; filtered light preserves the deep burgundy lace without bleaching
CareProfile.WaterDetails: Moderate; water deeply twice a week in hot weather, reduce in cool months
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Carefully remove dead threadleaf branches using fine scissors; avoid cutting live green growth
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -18°C; the finely cut leaves are more wind-sensitive than standard maples

SoilMix.Description: Moisture-holding yet breathable mix for the variegated Butterfly maple, preventing leaf scorch.

HomeRemedies.Title: Aloe Vera Root Drench
HomeRemedies.Description: Stimulates root growth and helps recover a thirsty, stressed plant quickly.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Blend 2 tbsp fresh aloe gel in 1 litre of water. Pour around base of plant. Repeat every 10 days during stress recovery.

HomeRemedies.Title: Diluted Liquid Kelp
HomeRemedies.Description: Restores nutrient balance and boosts variegated leaf colour contrast.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Mix 1 tbsp liquid kelp in 4 litres of water. Apply to soil every 2 weeks through spring and early summer.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Partial shade essential; variegated leaves are highly prone to sun scorch
CareProfile.WaterDetails: High moisture needs; water frequently and mist foliage in dry weather to prevent leaf scorch
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Light spring pruning to shape; reverted all-green shoots must be removed promptly
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -18°C; more cold-sensitive than plain-leaved maples, shelter in harsh winters

SoilMix.Description: Deep, moisture-retentive soil for this large-canopy native maple from the Pacific Northwest.

HomeRemedies.Title: Compost Tea Deep Feed
HomeRemedies.Description: Supports vigorous growth in this fast-growing large maple.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Brew 1 cup mature compost in 4 litres of water for 48 hours with aeration. Water deeply around the drip line monthly.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Partial sun to full sun; tolerates a wide range of light conditions
CareProfile.WaterDetails: High water needs; deep watering twice weekly in summer, the large leaf area loses moisture quickly
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Prune when fully dormant; this large tree tolerates hard pruning to control size
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -20°C; well-adapted to Pacific Northwest wet winters and dry summers

SoilMix.Description: Adaptable, free-draining general mix for this tough and ornamental variegated boxelder.

HomeRemedies.Title: Insecticidal Soap Spray
HomeRemedies.Description: Controls boxelder bugs and aphids without harming the ornamental foliage.
HomeRemedies.Instructions: Mix 1.5 tsp mild castile soap in 1 litre of water. Spray directly on insects and affected areas. Rinse foliage after 2 hours.

CareProfile.SunlightDetails: Full sun preferred; the pink and white variegation fades in shade
CareProfile.WaterDetails: Moderate watering; fairly drought-tolerant once established but performs better with regular moisture
CareProfile.PruningDetails: Hard pruning in early spring encourages fresh variegated growth; old wood loses colour
CareProfile.ThermalSensitivity: Hardy to -25°C; one of the most cold-hardy maple cultivars available
